# ~/.config/systemd/user/bag.service: the bag service's systemd user unit, one per user, for one home
[Unit]
Description=dev.bag.service

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart="/opt/homebrew/bin/node" "--disable-sigusr1" "/Users/x/.bag/package/bag-mcp.js" "--service" "--dir" "/Users/x/.bag" "--identities" "/Users/x/.bag/identities.json"
WorkingDirectory="/Users/x/.bag/run"
Environment="PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin"
Environment="HOME=/Users/x"
Environment="USER=x"
Environment="LANG=C"
Environment="AC_HOME=/Users/x/.bag"
Environment="HTTPS_PROXY=http://proxy:8080"
Environment="NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1"
UnsetEnvironment=NODE_OPTIONS NODE_PATH LD_PRELOAD
UMask=0077
LimitCORE=0
Restart=on-failure
StandardOutput=null
StandardError=append:/Users/x/.bag/run/service.log

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
